summary: Kingfish Holding Corp filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) disclosing that its subsidiary 6 LLC entered into a loan extension with Hancock Whitney Bank, extending the maturity to August 18, 2026. The principal is $1,519,179 at 6.735% interest, with 90-day extension increments. Kingfish is guarantor; all assets secure the loan. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation.
